# Maple Street Community Garden: FAQ

**Can I bring my dog?**
Dogs are allowed on a leash on the main paths only. They are not allowed inside plots.

**Who do I contact about a problem?**
Email the garden coordinator at coordinator@maplestreetgarden.example.

**What happens to my plot in winter?**
Plots must be cleared of dead plants by November 30. Garlic and perennial herbs may stay in the ground.

**Can I sell my vegetables?**
No. Produce from the garden is for personal use or donation. Extra produce can be left in the donation crate by the gate on Sundays, and it goes to the Maple Street Food Pantry.

**Is there parking?**
Street parking only. The lot next door belongs to the library and is not for garden use.
